about: The crates compiled into a download whose published source carries no licence text, and what the download carries for each, by name and version (scripts/dependency-licences.mjs). A crate not listed here that ships no text stops the build, and so does a new version of one listed. 'text' names a file another package of the same build ships, unchanged, by its SHA-256 (and by that package's name when it must be that one); null means the download carries no text for it and its list says so. 'used' is the side of a choice the text is for.

crates.name: gl
crates.why: Apache-2.0's text has no line of its own to fill: the standard text, as many crates of the same build ship it.
